nthe01.title: Aries Made a Group Chat
nthe01.caption: Aries made a group chat at 6 AM, asked for crush advice, then acted before anyone finished typing. Who's the Aries of your group chat?

nthe02.title: The RSVP Poll Has No "No"
nthe02.caption: Libra's party poll had three ways to say yes and zero ways to say no. Version two fixed that. Who in your chat needs a "no (totally fine!)" button?

nthe03.title: Sag Is Planning a Surprise
nthe03.caption: Sag's surprise trip plan was "vibes" and a 5 AM flight. One question to their person saved it. Do you love surprises, or love being asked first?

nthe04.title: Leo Pinned It Again
nthe04.caption: Leo pinned its own message again, then learned "when can I see you again?" counts as a compliment. Twice, even. Which sign pins its own wins?

nthe05.title: The Four-Minute Voice Note
nthe05.caption: Pisces sent a four-minute voice note, Gemini wrote the transcript, and the date passed a napkin. Who in your chat sends voice notes this long?

nthe06.title: The Secret Gift Exchange
nthe06.caption: Capricorn wrote the rules, Gemini drew itself twice, and Taurus found the perfect gift by remembering cold hands. What's the best small gift you've ever gotten?

nthe07.title: Cancer's Year-End Dinner
nthe07.caption: Cancer offered to cook for twelve, then admitted being tired at 1:12 AM. The chat claimed every dish in four seconds. Who's the Cancer of your friend group?

nthe08.title: Gemini, Three Replies at Once
nthe08.caption: Gemini answered three questions in one bubble, then tried something new: one question and a real wait. Are you a one-question texter or a three-at-once one?

nthe09.title: Item Six
nthe09.caption: Capricorn's agenda had six items. Item six was a date invite. Aquarius had been waiting since item one. Would your group chat have spotted item six?

nthe10.title: Scorpio Is Typing…
nthe10.caption: Scorpio typed for twenty minutes, sent "nvm", then sent the bravest sentence in the whole chat. Which sign takes the longest to hit send?

nthe11.title: Aquarius Renamed the Chat
nthe11.caption: Aquarius fixed a bike light and assumed that said everything. The chat suggested one more step: saying why out loud. Which sign shows love by fixing things?

nthe12.title: Virgo Needs Advice
nthe12.caption: Virgo always has the answer, until the crush is Virgo's. The chat answered with Virgo's own advice, word for word. Who gives your chat its best advice?

nthe13.title: Taurus Replied to Monday
nthe13.caption: Taurus answered Monday's soup question on Thursday, and meant it. Then kept the usual date spot and added a new one. Which sign replies four days later?

nthe14.title: Sag Was Honest. Very.
nthe14.caption: Sag told a date the dinner was a bit salty. True, but the chat had notes: lead with what you loved. Ever been honest a little too fast?

nthe15.title: Scorpio Asked Everyone
nthe15.caption: Scorpio asked everyone what makes their day better, totally not because of the gift exchange. Your turn: what small thing makes yours?

nthe16.title: Libra Practises Hello
nthe16.caption: Libra drafted forty greetings for the party. Virgo got it down to one line. Who's rehearsing hello in your group chat?
